The '''Recovery of the ''Sealion''''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]].

==Prelude==
[[Namuura Din]], the commanding officer of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Zeplin]]'', supplied both sensitive information pertaining to the true status of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and the [[Missile Boat]] prototype, the ''[[Sealion]]'', to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Link]]''. Although the ''Link'' and its crew had been captured before they could notify the Rebel Alliance of the truth at Endor, the ''Sealion'' had already been shipped to a Rebel outpost. Upon deducing from an Imperial scout within the region that the ''Sealion'' had not been relocated because no ships left the station since its arrival, the Imperials arrived at the area to investigate the containers for the ''Sealion'', and either retrieve or destroy the container to ensure the Rebels hadn't tampered with it to find out its secrets. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] was assigned to the sole remaining Missile Boat stationed on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']], the Tau 1, to locate the ''Sealion''{{'s}} container, with 5 [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] from [[Delta Squadron (TIE/LN)|Delta Squadron]] providing starfighter cover for the operation, and 3 [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] and 3 [[TIE/Advanced starfighter]]s from Zeta and Eta squadrons, respectively, placed on reserve. Just before the operation, the [[Priest (Secret Order of the Emperor)|Priest]] of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side]] told Maarek Steele that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] requested that they confirm whether the missile boat had already been disassembled by the Rebels or not, and as such, stated they would launch a craft to board the container and extract the craft after Steele identified the container containing the ''Sealion''.

==The Battle==
When Maarek Stele left the hanger, he helped TIE fighters engage and destroy [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] and [[R-41 Starchaser]]s. Before long, [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike Cruiser]] ''[[Piimi]]'' arrived to engage the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer ''Garrett'', only to be driven off, if not destroyed. Stele helped provide starfighter cover against multiple [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]]. After dealing with the Rebel fighters, he inspected the [[Class-B cargo container|Class-B]] [[Cargo container/Legends|containers]] [[Niicee]] to find each of them containing [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] until one of them had the missing Missile Boat. The ''Garrett'' then launched the [[Cargo ferry]] ''[[Omega 1]]'' under escort from Stele, then boarded the container and extracted the prototype. Stele then destroyed the container.

==Aftermath==
Upon locating the ''Sealion'', the Imperials deduced that the ''Sealion'' had not been touched by the time they found it. Nonetheless, because of both the theft and [[Demetrius Zaarin]] [[Destruction of the Missile Boat facilities|destroying]] all of the manufacturing plants for the Missile Boats via bombing, killing thousands in the process, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] recalled all surviving Missile Boats still in Imperial possession and placed them into protective storage until further notice, an order that ultimately wasn't rescinded due to his [[Battle of Endor/Legends|death]] at Endor. In part because of this, as well as [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] requesting Stele's skills in the final battle against Zaarin at [[To-phalion Base]], Stele was reassigned to the TIE/Advanced [[Alpha Squadron]] and sent to To-phalion Base to help Grand Admiral Thrawn hunt down Zaarin, once and for all.

==Behind the scenes==
This mission appears in the [[1994]] PC game ''Star Wars:TIE Fighter''.

The primary objective of the mission was to destroy the ''Sealion''{{'s}} container. However, a bonus objective could be achieved by waiting long enough after identifying it to have the ''Omega 1'' cargo ferry retrieve the ''Sealion''.

This article assumes completion of "Primary" and "Secondary" objectives. The "Bonus" objectives are the destruction of the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] ''[[Equator]]'', the [[XQ4 Platform]] ''[[Enin'sd]]'' and the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] ''[[Opos]]''.
